outline:
本實驗課程針對已有學習程式設計經驗的學生開設。本課程的主要目標為： 1.訓練學生有良好的Java程式設計能力 2.訓練學生有能力用電腦解決問題 3.訓練學生有能力看懂他人寫的程式
The course is designed for students with some programming experience. The course objects are: 1.Good Java programming 2.Problem solving through computer programming 3.Understand programs coded by the third party.
schedule:
Topic 1: JAVA流程控制練習 (Weeks 1-4)
Topic 2: 類別與物件練習 (Weeks 5-9)
Topic 3: 視窗程式設計練習 (Weeks 10-14)
Topic 4: 多執行緒練習 (Weeks 15-18)
